body:
Personal note — Wednesday before rain: wash off the gray foam left by the feed additive trial crew. my brother started coughing, and I had not yet heard that a deputy taped off the road.

I did not know where to put it after the shelves were cleared. There was still someone coming back for the answer written on it.

I thought someone would ask for this at the gate. They asked instead how many were in the car, and let the paper stay in my hand.
title: Wednesday before rain — gray foam
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same gray foam while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
